```{r}
  dplyr::mutate(Batch = as.numeric(counts[1,])) %>%

```

Add treatment
```{r}
treatment = read.csv("~/Documents/LungPredict_late_stage/Data/Captier/clinical_targets.csv", row.names = 1)

counts = counts[,colnames(counts)%in%rownames(clinical)]
```

Function for survival analysis
```{r}
compute.survival.analysis = function(survival.data, time_unit) {
  library(survival)

  # Prepare the data for survival analysis
  data_for_model <- data.frame("time" = survival.data$PFS,
                               "status" = survival.data$PFS_bin) 
  
  data_for_model$coxHL <- survival.data$group

  # Perform Kaplan-Meier based on coxHL
  km_fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time, status) ~ coxHL, data = data_for_model)
  
  pval <- survminer::surv_pvalue(km_fit, data = data_for_model)$pval #Performs log-rank test to see whether both survival curves are significantly different
  
  ### Set colors of each curve with the correct order 
  strata_names <- gsub("coxHL=", "", names(km_fit$strata)) 
  legend_labels <- strata_names
  legend.labs = legend_labels

  pdf("Results/SurvPlot_DEG_groups", width = 10, height = 5, onefile = FALSE)
  print(survminer::ggsurvplot(km_fit,
                   data = data_for_model,
                   size = 1,
                   conf.int.style = "step",
                   pval = TRUE,
                   risk.table = TRUE,
                   risk.table.col = "strata",
                   legend.labs = legend.labs,
                   risk.table.height = 0.3,
                   ggtheme = theme_grey(),
                   title = paste0("Cox PH for Surv(time, status) ~ patient groups"),
                   xlab = paste0("Time to death/recurrence/progression (", time_unit, ")")
  ))
  dev.off()

}
```

Compute survival analysis
```{r}
res_clusters = compute.survival.analysis(clinical, "months")
```

Batch effect - PCA
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify) 
# Ensure Groups is in the data
df_plot <- as.data.frame(t(counts_all))
df_plot$Groups <- factor(clinical_all$Cohort)  # add Groups column

# Run PCA
counts_scaled <- t(counts_all)
# remove genes with zero variance
counts_scaled <- counts_scaled[, apply(counts_scaled, 2, var) != 0]

pca_result <- prcomp(counts_scaled, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Plot PCA
autoplot(pca_result, data = df_plot, 
         colour = 'Groups',   # column name as string
         label = FALSE, 
         size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("PCA") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
  labs(colour = "Cohorts")
```

Survival analysis
```{r}
compute.survival.analysis = function(data, value_name, survival.data, time_unit, file_name) {
  library(survival)
  library(survminer)
  
  # Example: using Group2vs4_markers score as continuous predictor
  data_for_model <- data.frame(time = survival.data$PFS,
                               status = survival.data$PFS_bin,
                               response = survival.data$Progression,
                               score  = data[,value_name]
  )
  
  # Cox PH model with continuous score
  cox_model <- coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ score, data = data_for_model)
  summary_cox <- summary(cox_model)
  
  hr  <- summary_cox$coef[1, "exp(coef)"]    # hazard ratio
  pval <- summary_cox$coef[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]    # p-value
  
  message("Cox PH model: HR = ", round(hr, 3), 
          " (95% CI ", round(summary_cox$conf.int[1,3], 3), "-", 
                         round(summary_cox$conf.int[1,4], 3), 
          "), p = ", signif(pval, 3))
  
  # Dichotomize only for visualization (median split)
  data_for_model$group <- ifelse(data_for_model$score >= median(data_for_model$score, na.rm=TRUE),
                                 "High", "Low")
  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ group, data = data_for_model)
  
  # KM plot without log-rank p-value, only Cox PH in subtitle
  pdf(paste0("Results/SurvPlot_DEG_groups_", file_name), width = 10, height = 5, onefile = FALSE)
  print(
    ggsurvplot(
      km_fit, data = data_for_model,
      pval = FALSE,  # remove log-rank test
      risk.table = TRUE,
      risk.table.col = "strata",
      size = 1,
      conf.int = FALSE,
      legend.labs = c("Low score", "High score"),
      ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
      title = paste0("Survival by DEG signature score (", time_unit, ")"),
      xlab = paste0("Time to death/recurrence/progression (", time_unit, ")"),
      subtitle = paste0("Cox PH (continuous): HR=", round(hr,3), ", p=", signif(pval,3))
    )
  )
  dev.off()
  
  return(list(cox_model = cox_model, hr = hr, pval = pval))
}

```

Compute survival analysis
```{r}
res_clusters = compute.survival.analysis(sig_scores, "Group4vs2_markers", clinical, "months", file_name = "Captier_group4vs2")
```
